build_gradient_boosting_regressor: build a GradientBoostingRegressor model with squared_error loss and 500 estimators for diabetes regression
split_dataset_train_test: split a dataset into 90% training and 10% testing sets using train_test_split with a fixed random state
compute_mean_squared_error: compute the mean squared error between true labels and predicted values on a test set
plot_training_deviance: plot training and test set deviance against boosting iterations for a fitted GradientBoostingRegressor
compute_permutation_importance: compute permutation importances for feature importance analysis on a held-out test set
